title: A2UI ReactApp Catalog (labs)
description: Defines the `ReactApp` component: a small React app, written by the agent as one TSX file, that renders in a sandboxed frame next to the native components and talks to the surface data model and catalog functions through the `a2ui` module.
instructions: Use `ReactApp` only for interactive UI the native components can't express: custom charts with interactions, drag and drop, brushing, canvases, timers or games. Build everything else (labels, sliders, text fields, buttons, lists) from native components, and connect them to the app through shared data model paths. The app reads and writes those paths with `useData(path, fallback)` from the `a2ui` module, and calls catalog or agent functions with `callFunction(name, args)`. Write `source` as one raw triple-quoted string, `r"""..."""`, inline in the `ReactApp(...)` call.

ReactApp.description: A small interactive React app written as one TSX file. It renders in an isolated frame inside the surface, sized by `height`. The app can import only `react` and `a2ui`. Through `a2ui` it reads, writes and subscribes to data model paths (`useData`, `getData`, `setData`, `subscribe`), calls catalog and agent functions (`callFunction`, `useFunction`), dispatches actions (`dispatchAction`), draws Vega-Lite charts (`VegaChart`) and uses styled primitives (`Card`, `Button`, `Text`, `Slider`, `Stack`) that match the native components. The app has no network access and no access to the host page.

source.description: The complete TSX source of the app: one file that default-exports a component named `App`, which takes no props. Import only from `react` and `a2ui`. Read and write data model paths with `useData`, never with props or globals. Style with the `a2ui` primitives or `var(--a2ui-*)` CSS variables; don't hard-code colors or fonts. Write it as a raw triple-quoted string `r"""..."""`: nothing inside is escaped, and it must never contain three double quotes in a row.

title.description: A short title for the app. It is the accessible name of the frame and the heading of its error card.

height.description: The height of the frame in CSS pixels. Defaults to 360. Pick a height that fits the app without scrolling; the app can ask for more at runtime.

dataPaths.description: Optional allowlist of data model paths the app may read and write, as JSON pointers. A request for one of these paths, or a path below one, is allowed; any other path is rejected. Omit it to allow every path. List the paths the app passes to `useData`, `getData`, `setData` and `subscribe`.

functions.description: Optional allowlist of the function names the app may call with `callFunction` or `useFunction`. Omit it to allow every function the surface's catalogs declare or the agent provides.

compiled.description: The app compiled to plain JavaScript (an ES module). Set by the agent server after it checks `source`; never write this property yourself. When present, the frame runs it and skips compiling `source` in the browser.
